services.name: All Charters
services.desc: Limit Action has been the norm on our Halibut Trips this season! The Squid and Anchovies have been present all season and all over keeping anglers spread out and the fishing consistent. This trend will hopefully continue for the near future. 05/05/2025 Limit fishing both Quality Rockfish and Lingcod on all trips! Friday: we had 50 jumbo Black and Vermilion Rockfish & 10 lb Lingcod on the ultralight gear. Sunday: we Landed 10 nice keeper Lingcod while attempting for Halibut(no takers) we kept 2 limits at the end of the day for the ride home. 4/10/2025 Forecast was a little off but our team made the best of it. We were greeted with a stiff 18kt NW wind making staying on the fish challenging

blurb: King Salmon are the most desired gamefish we have in the Monterey Bay area. We have been Sport and Commercially fishing them since 1972. Our bay has one of the largest boimass of bait anywhere in the world, bringing hungry Salmon by the thousands. April is primetime here since commercial seasons opens in May and we have a limited quota. We will run to wherever the best spot is so a Fuel surcharge may apply for
